messages:
kevin: Noticed a ~180ms p95 bump for /v1/generate (prod) right after we adjusted routing weights. No infra deploy. https://console.redwood/shot.png
meera: thanks — quick check: per-route p95s look unchanged. Endpoint p95 moved when dedicated went from 30% -> 70%. This smells like a merged-sketch effect.
olga: yep. We merge TDigest-like sketches across routes for endpoint views. When sample composition shifts the merged quantile can move even with steady nodes.
sara: That caused a pager for the SLO team. Can we short-term add a banner that says "Percentiles aggregated across routes; routing or quota changes may shift numbers" + a link to an explainer?
kevin: +1 for banner. Also we should give SREs a conservative option for alerts (route-aware).
meera: API quick proposal: add `aggregation` param values `merged` (default), `per_route_weighted`, `per_route_conservative` (returns max pctl across routes) and `include_provenance=true` to return sample counts per route. Backwards compatible.
olga: example curl: `GET /metrics?metric=latency_p95&endpoint=/v1/generate&aggregation=per_route_conservative&include_provenance=true` returns p95 and counts by route.
sara: UI idea: a thin "origin-strip" above charts showing percentages, e.g., "hosted 28% | dedicated 72%" and a small "breakdown" chevron to flip to per-route percentile lines. Tooltip: "Aggregated via sketch-merge; use conservative aggregation for SLOs."
kevin: For alerting guidance: prefer route-bound SLOs when routes differ in latency profile. If using endpoint-level SLO stick to `per_route_conservative` to avoid noise during rollouts. Add a min-sample guard too.
meera: telemetry note: when quota-driven reroutes occur emit event `reroute.reason=quota` so the console can annotate pctl timelines and speed up triage.
olga: I'll draft the RFC for `aggregation` + provenance payload and add compatibility examples. Will include unit tests that flip weights and assert per-route stability.
sara: I'll mock the origin-strip and the explainer modal; will add banner copy and link to the RFC.
metrics-bot: metric-alert: p95 threshold exceeded for /v1/generate at 2025-11-02T14:12:08Z.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: console-origin-strip -> 2025-11-03T02:00:00Z (banner + strip behind feature flag).
kevin: Owners: kevin -> runbook + alert guidance, olga -> API RFC/impl, meera -> telemetry + tests, sara -> UI canary. If we can land API flag + UI strip next deploy we should cut down on pager noise.
